title: Speaking
description: A recorded, face-to-face interview with an examiner in three parts, 11–14 minutes. The same test for Academic and General Training.

id.title: Speaking
id.description: Wawancara tatap muka dengan penguji yang direkam, tiga bagian, 11–14 menit. Tesnya sama untuk Academic dan General Training.

nodes.title: Part 1: Introduction & Interview
nodes.summary: Answer short questions about yourself and familiar topics such as home, work, studies and interests.

objectives.text: Answer familiar-topic questions in two or three sentences with a reason or example
Use present, past and future forms correctly when talking about routines, experiences and plans
Start answers naturally without repeating the question word for word

id.title: Part 1: Perkenalan & Wawancara
id.summary: Menjawab pertanyaan singkat tentang diri sendiri dan topik sehari-hari seperti rumah, pekerjaan, studi dan minat.

objectives.extended-answers: Menjawab pertanyaan topik sehari-hari dalam dua atau tiga kalimat dengan alasan atau contoh
objectives.tense-control: Memakai bentuk present, past dan future dengan benar saat membicarakan rutinitas, pengalaman dan rencana
objectives.natural-openers: Memulai jawaban secara alami tanpa mengulang pertanyaan kata per kata

nodes.title: Part 2: Long Turn (Task Card)
nodes.summary: Use one minute to make notes, then speak for up to two minutes on the topic on the task card.

objectives.text: Make useful keyword notes covering every prompt on the task card in one minute
Speak for close to two minutes with a clear beginning, middle and end
Narrate a past experience or describe a person, place or object with past tenses and descriptive language

id.title: Part 2: Long Turn (Kartu Tugas)
id.summary: Memakai satu menit untuk membuat catatan, lalu berbicara hingga dua menit tentang topik di kartu tugas.

objectives.one-minute-notes: Membuat catatan kata kunci yang mencakup semua poin di kartu tugas dalam satu menit
objectives.speak-two-minutes: Berbicara mendekati dua menit dengan pembuka, isi dan penutup yang jelas
objectives.narrate-describe: Menceritakan pengalaman masa lalu atau mendeskripsikan orang, tempat atau benda dengan past tense dan bahasa deskriptif

nodes.title: Part 3: Discussion
nodes.summary: Discuss more abstract questions linked to the Part 2 topic: compare, speculate and justify opinions.

objectives.text: Give and justify an opinion on an abstract issue with reasons and examples
Speculate about the future or hypothetical situations using conditionals and modals
Compare different perspectives (past and present, young and old, different countries) and hedge where appropriate

id.title: Part 3: Diskusi
id.summary: Membahas pertanyaan yang lebih abstrak terkait topik Part 2: membandingkan, berspekulasi dan memberi alasan atas pendapat.

objectives.justify-opinions: Memberi dan membela pendapat tentang isu abstrak dengan alasan dan contoh
objectives.speculate: Berspekulasi tentang masa depan atau situasi hipotetis dengan conditional dan modal
objectives.compare-perspectives: Membandingkan sudut pandang berbeda (dulu dan sekarang, muda dan tua, negara berbeda) dan memperhalus pernyataan bila perlu

nodes.title: Fluency, Coherence & Pronunciation
nodes.summary: Keep talking smoothly, organise ideas and speak clearly, as the Speaking criteria reward.

objectives.text: Explain the four Speaking criteria: Fluency and coherence, Lexical resource, Grammatical range and accuracy, Pronunciation
Use natural fillers and self-correction to keep speaking instead of stopping
Pronounce word endings, word stress and sentence stress clearly enough to be understood easily

id.title: Kelancaran, Koherensi & Pelafalan
id.summary: Tetap berbicara dengan lancar, menata ide dan berbicara dengan jelas, sesuai kriteria penilaian Speaking.

objectives.speaking-criteria: Menjelaskan empat kriteria Speaking: Fluency and coherence, Lexical resource, Grammatical range and accuracy, Pronunciation
objectives.fillers-repair: Memakai filler yang alami dan koreksi diri agar tetap berbicara dan tidak berhenti
objectives.clear-sounds: Melafalkan akhiran kata, tekanan kata dan tekanan kalimat cukup jelas agar mudah dipahami
